items.title: Here's what happened in crypto today
items.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: EU authority classifies Circle's USDC as 'significant' under MiCA
items.summary: The second-largest stablecoin by market cap will be overseen by French and EU authorities under its classification as a "significant e-money token."

items.title: US authorities dismantle crypto scam network that stole tens of millions
items.summary: Brooklyn prosecutors and the FBI seized 112 servers and shut down 241 websites linked to investment scams that targeted Russian-speaking Americans.

items.title: OCC report finds debanking efforts tied to crypto activities
items.summary: The report from the US banking regulator did not include specific examples of debanking related to crypto, but mentioned it alongside ties to oil, gas and firearms.

items.title: Standard Chartered pushes $2T stablecoin forecast to 2030 as transaction volumes grow
items.summary: The bank identified four distinct stablecoin markets, with USDC leading payments and AI transactions as competition intensifies over reserve yields.

items.title: Bitcoin price dips below $82K as high oil prices spike US CPI inflation
items.summary: Bitcoin fell below $82,000 while bond yields targeted new 24-year highs on the back of hot US CPI inflation.

items.title: Russia's Biggest Bank Sberbank Wins Approval to Trade Bitcoin
items.summary: Sberbank now holds both custody and exchange status under Russia's new crypto law, and plans to bring Bitcoin, Ethereum and USDT to apps used by 110 million retail clients.

items.title: Solana Sets a Date for Its Next Major Upgrade
items.summary: Solana's Alpenglow upgrade replaces the TowerBFT voting system on October 21, cutting finality from 12.8 seconds to a target of 150ms and pulling vote transactions out of blocks entirely.

items.title: Standard Chartered Opens Bitcoin and Ethereum Trading to Wealthy UAE Clients
items.summary: The British bank won Dubai regulatory approval to let affluent clients buy BTC and ETH straight from their bank accounts, with custody and settlement kept in-house.

items.title: 'It Can Take Years': Coinbase Presses for Bitcoin Quantum Migration to Start Now
items.summary: The exchange argued that a multi-year migration to quantum-resistant cryptography must begin before Q-Day arrives.

items.title: Bitcoin Falls as Hot Inflation Puts a Fed Hike Back on the Table
items.summary: September CPI hit 3.7%, above forecasts, sending Treasury yields higher and pressuring risk assets.

items.title: Hex Founder Richard Heart Detained in Istanbul on Interpol Red Notice: Report
items.summary: Turkish authorities detained the Hex and PulseChain founder following an Interpol notice.

items.title: Major shareholder presses SkyAI on Solana sales after treasury shrinks 70% in a month
items.summary: SkyAI's SOL treasury fell 70% in under a month, with 400,000 SOL unexplained. Bastion Trading won't tender at $3 a share and wants $3.50.

items.title: 'You're committing crime in broad daylight': Kalshi CEO defends prediction markets amid insider trading concerns
items.summary: As insider trading concerns are accumulating, one of the biggest platforms said its markets make it easier to suss out bad actors.

items.title: Bitcoin falls below $82,000 as hotter core CPI revives Fed hike concerns
items.summary: Bitcoin dropped below $82,000 after September's core CPI beat forecasts as analysts weigh price targets and an October hike.

items.title: Hex and PulseChain founder Richard Heart detained in Istanbul: reports
items.summary: Turkish reports say $4 million and 64 watches were seized. Police have yet to confirm Heart's detention.

items.title: Standard Chartered pushes $2 trillion stablecoin market forecast to 2030 as supply growth stalls
items.summary: Standard Chartered Bank has pushed its $2 trillion stablecoin market forecast to 2030 from 2028 because supply growth has stalled this year.

items.title: StarkWare launches OffMarket to let Polymarket users trade more privately
items.summary: OffMarket allows Polymarket users to trade without publicly linking positions.

items.title: Kraken moves to acquire $181 million European bank in major push beyond crypto trading
items.summary: Kraken parent Payward targets Saldo Bank acquisition to expand banking services.

items.title: Ripple targets trillion-dollar securities markets with new US brokerage and South Korean deals
items.summary: Ripple calls Meritz its fourth Korean institutional partner this year, with custody and tokenization cooperation to widen as regulation develops.

items.title: Ethereum's quantum race takes a new turn as zkSync courts banks and Starknet weighs exit
items.summary: ZkSync announced Airbender Prime prover. Starknet considering independent L1.

items.title: Strive's new $500 million Bitcoin financing plan comes with a $257 million annual dividend problem
items.summary: Hypothetical $500 million SATS financing assigns $387.5 million to Bitcoin.

items.title: HEX founder Richard Heart arrested with 'electronic devices' in Istanbul via Interpol
items.summary: Reports of detention of Hex founder in Istanbul.

items.title: Bitcoin Fog operator's conviction upheld without Chainalysis disclosing source code
items.summary: Court upheld conviction of Bitcoin Fog operator.

items.title: Kraken Parent Company Payward to Buy Saldo Bank in European Banking Push
items.summary: Kraken pushing to offer other services beyond digital assets.

items.title: Standard Chartered Debuts Bitcoin Trading For Wealthy UAE Clients
items.summary: Bank allows affluent clients to buy BTC and ETH from accounts.

items.title: The Undercurrent: Three European Artists on Making Money Visible
items.summary: Artists explore money and Bitcoin themes.

items.title: Bitcoin Slips Below $83,000 After Hotter-Than-Expected US Inflation Data
items.summary: Bitcoin slid after US consumer prices shot up more than expected due to rising gasoline.

items.title: Capitalism is Broken and Bitcoin is the Great Equalizer | Natalie Brunell
items.summary: Discussion on Bitcoin as equalizer.

items.title: Blue Coin Capital CIO: MSTR'S BTC Buying Engine is About to IGNITE | Mike Treidel
items.summary: Interview on MicroStrategy Bitcoin strategy.

items.title: Kalshi CEO says state-led oversight of U.S. prediction markets would push them out
items.summary: CEO Tarek Mansour said he feels "pretty good" about the pending outcome of the current legal fight over who has the right to regulate prediction markets.

items.title: AI agents make 138 million crypto payments as U.S. dominates spending on AI models
items.summary: U.S.-linked wallets account for just over 88% of tracked AI model payments, dwarfing China's 0.1% share, according to new Chainalysis research.

items.title: Crypto Long & Short: Why gold and bitcoin belong in the same portfolio
items.summary: Analysis on portfolio allocation including gold and bitcoin.

items.title: EasyA hits $1.1 billion valuation, targets 2027 public listing and tokenized shares
items.summary: The blockchain and AI developer platform has completed two years of audits and wants its shares available onchain from the first day of trading.

items.title: BlackRock's crypto ETF assets surge 63% but remain far below 2025 peak
items.summary: The asset manager's crypto assets surged 63% to $79.6 billion as investors returned, but holdings remain 23% below year-ago levels.

items.title: Former FTX Europe chief targets U.S. tokenized stock trading with new SEC exemption
items.summary: Nasdaq-listed Perpetuals.com is the second company to pursue a U.S. tokenized stock marketplace under the SEC's new framework, following a joint venture between OKX and NYSE parent ICE.
